title: Instead of Pausing Sustainability Reporting, the EU Proposes Simplifying and Minimizing the Burden of Its Reporting Requirements
content: As summarized in “SEC Climate Disclosure Rule: Paused but Reporting Requirements Remain,” one of the first actions of the Trump Administration was for the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to pause its defense of the climate disclosure rule. While this action does not invalidate the climate rule, it simply puts it in regulatory limbo—unenforced but not erased.
author: David W. South
